title: One-tape time in two-fifths-power space
coordinate: The space exponent for one writable tape. The published bound is 2/5, below the older square-root exponent.
note: The simulator determines the finite-control and halting outcome by time T. Its own running time is unrestricted. Finitely many read-only input heads are allowed.

try.hint: A later record is a smaller proven space exponent than 2/5. Use an exact expression strictly between 0 and 1. Lower stays the direction, so a smaller value is the later record.

source.title: Simulating One-Tape Time in Two-Fifths-Power Space
